hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was toggled from off to on starting at 2026-09-14T00:01:00Z (a partial ramp: 137 off / 63 on that minute, fully on from 00:02). Requests served with the flag on hit a ZeroDivisionError on the account page, driving the error rate from ~1% baseline to 26-32%.

supporting_evidence.claim: 2026-09-14T00:01:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero (new error class; before 00:01 the only errors were UpstreamTimeout: payment authorization timed out)
error_rate goes 0.005 at 2026-09-14T00:00:00Z -> 0.095 at 00:01 -> 0.265 at 00:02 -> 0.32 at 00:06, with request_volume flat at 1200 and latency unchanged
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-13T18:00:00Z to 2026-09-14T00:06:00Z. (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: Alternative: latent defective code already deployed earlier than the change lookback window, only exposed now by the flag ramp. No deploy appears in the 6-hour change window, so a bad deployment is not directly evidenced; the flag toggle remains the proximate trigger.
